frame: legacy-v06 (same glyph-local frame as the authored family, y down)

provenance.author: Claude (AI), NIGHTSHIFT implementation session
provenance.roadmap: C02 Wave 3 (contracts/alphabet-authoring-plan.v1.json: diagonal, branch, valley and crossing systems K M N V W X Y Z)
provenance.method: Constructed from stroke edges: every diagonal has two exactly parallel edges at a perpendicular thickness of 25 units (tools/lib/wave3-construction.mjs, coordinates rounded to whole units); stems 26 and bars 23 as in the authored family; cap height 8–132. Not traced or derived from any font, artwork, photograph or identifiable writer.

notes: Never edit by hand without bumping version; geometry changes after import go through editor commands.
The legacy v0.6 provisional base of each glyph is kept as a reference-only second variant.
Measured v0.6 diagonal thicknesses varied from 19.6 to 28 units; the masters hold 24.2–26.1.

K.brief: Spine with an upper arm and a lower leg meeting at a branch point right of the spine; arm and leg have parallel edges (perpendicular thickness 25).

M.brief: Two full-height stems; two diagonals descend from the inner top corners and meet on the axis (valley), leaving a top notch.

N.brief: Two full-height stems joined by one diagonal from the top of the left stem to the foot of the right stem.

V.brief: Two diagonals meeting at a flat foot on the baseline; symmetric about x=52.

W.brief: Two Vs with one slope throughout; middle apex at cap height, two inner notches and a middle valley.

X.brief: Two straight strokes crossing at the centre; four notches.

Y.brief: Two arms meeting above a centred stem (stem identical to T).

Z.brief: Top and foot bars joined by a diagonal from the top right to the bottom left.
